name: Aloxe-Corton

limits: For white wine, Pinot Blanc: at most 10%
For red wine, Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris, only mixed in among the Pinot Noir vines: at most 15% of each plot

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Bourgogne, village, Premier Cru, Grand Cru
Burgundy's four levels, from regional Bourgogne up through village wines to Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards.

notes: Aloxe-Corton reds are fairly dark, ruby to garnet in color.
They smell and taste of red and black fruit, and they are robust and structured.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune village appellation in Burgundy for red wine from Pinot Noir and white from Chardonnay. Its commune holds vineyards of all three Corton hill grand crus: Corton, Corton-Charlemagne and Charlemagne.
